_doc: Player character creation rules for TalesForge.CharacterCreation: the stat point buy from rules/core_mechanics.md (75 points, 3-18 per stat), the race stat choices from rules/races.md, the skill rules (budget, level costs, caps, class package, race skill bonuses), the past occupation for skills, the derivation inputs for a new player character and the starting kit. Race and class labels come from defaults.json.

skills._doc: Skill rules ported from the old game (docs/game-rules: fantasy_rpg_game_mechanics_summary.md, racial_mechanics_summary.md; modules/merovingia/game-system.json). level_costs[n-1] is the price of level n: levels 1-3 cost 1, 4-5 cost 2, 6-7 (signature only) cost 3. Free levels (class package, race bonus, past occupation) fill the lowest levels and cost nothing. A skill above cap is a signature skill: at most signature_max of them, up to signature_cap. Free levels the caps cut off come back as points at the price of the levels lost (past the signature cap at the signature price).

occupation._doc: A player character's past occupation, from the defaults.json occupation tables: free levels on its core skills (core_bonus) and secondary skills (secondary_bonus), stacked on the class package and race bonus. choices are the occupations a player may pick; class_defaults the suggestion per class. It feeds the skills and, as for NPCs, the OCEAN, Maslow and concerns defaults (derive.occupation is only the fallback).

races.human: Versatile and resilient; humans adapt quickly, thriving on trial and error. +1 to any two stats, +5 skill points.
races.elf: Graceful, long-lived and attuned to nature and magic. +2 DEX, +1 INT or WIS, -1 CON; Ranged Combat +3, Survival +2.
races.dwarf: Sturdy craftsfolk who endure harsh conditions. +2 CON, +1 STR, -1 CHA; Melee Combat +3, Survival +2.
races.gnome: Curious tinkerers who treat failures as experiments. +2 INT, +1 DEX, -1 STR; Arcana +3, Lockpicking +2.
races.halfling: Cheerful, social and lucky in danger. +2 DEX, +1 CHA, -1 STR; Stealth +3, Lockpicking +2.
races.half_elf: Bridging two worlds, with human adaptability and elven grace. +1 DEX, +1 CHA, +3 skill points.

occupations.laborer: Hauled, dug and built for a day's wage.
occupations.innkeep: Kept an inn: rooms, rumours and regulars.
occupations.barkeep: Poured drinks and kept the peace across the bar.
occupations.merchant: Bought cheap, sold dear and read every buyer.
occupations.guard: Stood watch on a gate, a wall or someone important.
occupations.soldier: Marched, drilled and fought in someone's war.
occupations.hunter: Tracked game through the wilds to feed a village.
occupations.miner: Worked the dark seams under the hills.
occupations.priest: Served a temple, its rites and its people.
occupations.scholar: Studied old books, older languages and stranger lore.
occupations.thief: Lived off locks, pockets and shadows.
occupations.noble: Grew up at court among titles, manners and feuds.

classes.none: No trade of arms or magic: your past and your choices speak for you.
classes.warrior: Trained to fight: melee, tactics and a hard stare.
classes.thief: Quiet hands and a quick tongue: stealth, locks and lies.
classes.ranger: At home in the wild: bow, tracks and survival.
classes.cleric: A voice of faith: insight, persuasion and old stories.
classes.wizard: A student of the arcane: arcana, history and insight.
classes.druid: Bound to the land: survival, arcana and tracking.
